environment: Isolated Chrome profiles at 390px on the existing Windows build host; synthetic text, media and analytics, not actual audience outcomes.
limitations: The channel profile is user-authored guidance, not a trained model.
Review flags and exact-word similarity are heuristics, not semantic originality or outcome predictions.
Retention is user-imported; no platform account connection is established.
Audience filtering is partial, not complete anonymisation.
No claim that these features are unique across all competing products.
